title: Chapter 39
text: 38 He found forty, of which he only really liked two: “rose rot” and “to err so.” 39 See inbred girl; lie breeds grin; leering debris; greed be nil, sir; be idle re. rings; ringside rebel; residing rebel; etc. 40 That’s true. Much of the meter in Don Juan only works if you read Juan as bi-syllabic. 41 Spanish. 42 Italian. 43 German. 44 French and English. 45 Russian. 46 Greek. 47 Latin. 48 Arabic.
